exam.title: CompTIA Tech+
exam.study_prerequisites: No prior experience is required. Build practical technology literacy across computing and notation, devices/components/storage/interfaces, virtualization/cloud/networking, operating systems/applications/browsers/AI, basic programming logic, data/databases/backups, troubleshooting, and security; verify the FC0-U71 versus FC0-U71-CE lifecycle choice during purchase.

review.notes: All six weighted V6 domains and public subtopics are mapped to connected explanations, three scenarios, eight safe labs and 40 original checks. The official no-expiration FC0-U71/five-year FC0-U71-CE wording is preserved. All ten URLs are cataloged: eight reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. No proprietary objective PDF, course content, or recalled questions are used.

findings.title: Full objectives needed finer teaching coverage
findings.evidence: The PDF contains31 numbered objectives, including 2.7 internet services and 6.5 wireless configuration, versus29 summary rows on the main page.
findings.recommendation: Map all 31 IDs and add internet-service comparison, explicit wireless setup/verification, fuller device/browser/privacy details and two checks.
findings.resolution: Map all 31 IDs and add internet-service comparison, explicit wireless setup/verification, fuller device/browser/privacy details and two checks.

findings.title: Units needed worked calculations and notation correction
findings.evidence: NIST distinguishes decimal MB from binary MiB and bits from bytes; PDF1.3uses a mixed Terabytes/Tbps example.
findings.recommendation: Teach explicit units, binary/hex/octal conversion and a 100 MB at 80 Mbps calculation without copying the typo.
findings.resolution: Teach explicit units, binary/hex/octal conversion and a 100 MB at 80 Mbps calculation without copying the typo.

findings.title: Database relationships and backups needed observable behavior
findings.evidence: SQLite foreign-key enforcement must be enabled per connection before a transaction; a declared key alone is insufficient.
findings.recommendation: Add actual constraint failures, a left-join/COUNT distinction, independent backup and reopened synthetic restore checks.
findings.resolution: Add actual constraint failures, a left-join/COUNT distinction, independent backup and reopened synthetic restore checks.

findings.title: Exam password vocabulary needed current-policy context
findings.evidence: Objectives mention expiration and complexity; current NIST centrally verified password guidance rejects periodic rotation and composition rules while requiring compromise-driven change.
findings.recommendation: Explain the terms without making universal rotation advice; retain scoped 15/8 minimums, unique secrets, MFA and recovery.
findings.resolution: Explain the terms without making universal rotation advice; retain scoped 15/8 minimums, unique secrets, MFA and recovery.

findings.title: Private browsing did not fully explain persistent artifacts
findings.evidence: Current Firefox reference distinguishes session data from saved downloads/bookmarks and does not claim internet anonymity.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit artifact and synchronization boundaries; browser lab remains proposed.
findings.resolution: Add explicit artifact and synchronization boundaries; browser lab remains proposed.

findings.recommendation: Label these as current provider estimates, not guaranteed personal completion times.
findings.resolution: Label these as current provider estimates, not guaranteed personal completion times.
